overview: The Community Development Board approved site plan review and multiple zoning waivers for the new Tufts University Aquatic Center, recommended City Council approval of easements along Main Street for a MassDOT safety project, and approved site plan modifications for 99 Revere Beach Parkway. The board also released subdivision covenants on Mary Kenny Way and discussed hearing schedules for the Boston Avenue zoning corridor.

items.title: Alteration of Public Way and Easements: Main Street
items.summary: The board voted to recommend that the City Council approve layout alterations and both temporary and permanent easements along Main Street and Mystic Avenue to enable a MassDOT safety and signalization improvement project.

items.title: Release of Covenants: Mary Kenny Way
items.summary: The board approved releasing lots 6, 7, and 8 from the subdivision covenant for Mary Kenny Way, authorizing Director Hunt to sign the release on behalf of the board while the city continues to hold cash surety and covenants on the remaining lots.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 130 College Avenue (Tufts Aquatic Center)
items.summary: After finding the project protected under the Dover Amendment and approving waivers for setbacks, multiple structures, solar canopy requirements, and shared parking, the board approved the site plan with 24 conditions that include a raised crosswalk on College Avenue and expanded community swim access.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Inclusionary Zoning
items.summary: The board voted to continue the public hearing on the inclusionary zoning amendment regarding fractional payment formulas to June 17, 2026.

items.title: Site Plan Modification: 99 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: The board approved modifications to the previously approved site plan, reducing parking garage capacity from 238 to 209 spaces to avoid an Enbridge gas pipeline easement, reconfiguring ground-floor delivery and drop-off areas, and adding six inches to building height for Passive House insulation.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The board approved meeting minutes from March 4 and May 6, 2026, with an amendment clarifying height and story details for a Mystic Avenue review.

items.title: Administrative and Zoning Project Updates
items.summary: The board and staff discussed hearing logistics and community outreach for the Boston Avenue corridor rezoning ahead of June meetings, as well as establishing earlier design review protocols for future Tufts University projects.
